name: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 turbofan run-to-failure (single operating condition / single fault mode) — hourly PHM telemetry — remaining useful life (RUL) (univariate RUL forecasting bundle)
citation: A. Saxena and K. Goebel (2008). "Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Data Set", NASA Prognostics Data Repository, NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, CA. Official repository: https://www.nasa.gov/intelligent-systems-division/discovery-and-systems-health/pcoe/pcoe-data-set-repository/. Download mirror used by this pipeline: https://zenodo.org/records/15346912 (CMAPSSData.zip). Related paper: Saxena, A., Goebel, K., Simon, D., & Eklund, N. (2008). Damage Propagation Modeling for Aircraft Engine Run-to-Failure Simulation. International Conference on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM08).
license: U.S. government / NASA Ames PCoE public research data (public domain in the U.S.; attribute Saxena & Goebel 2008). Zenodo mirror redistributes the same archive.
description: Turbofan remaining useful life. This bundle forecasts `remaining_useful_life` (cycles mapped to hours until failure). Source: NASA C-MAPSS / PCoE turbofan degradation simulation (Saxena & Goebel 2008); pipeline download = Zenodo https://zenodo.org/records/15346912/files/CMAPSSData.zip?download=1. Exemplar longest unit only; hourly cadence via cycle→hour mapping; 362 rows; 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z..2020-01-16T01:00:00Z. Windows: context_window=168, forecast_horizon=14. C-MAPSS is the PHM community gold-standard for remaining useful life benchmarking.
preprocessing: 1. download_cmapss.py: GET Zenodo record 15346912 CMAPSSData.zip → data/maintenance/cmapss/raw/; unzip to CMAPSSData/.
2. transform_cmapss.py: read train_FD001.txt (whitespace-separated, no header) with columns unit_id, cycle, op_setting_1..3, then 21 sensors (T2..W32).
3. FD001 = single operating condition + single fault mode (easiest C-MAPSS subset).
4. Select the longest run-to-failure unit by max(cycle) as the TempusBench exemplar trajectory.
5. remaining_useful_life = max_cycle - cycle; failure_probability_14d = 1.0 iff RUL <= 14 (matches forecast_horizon=14).
6. Drop near-constant sensors {T2, P2, P15, epr, farB, Nf_dmd, PCNfR_dmd}; keep T24,T30,T50,P30,Nf,Nc,Ps30,phi,NRf,NRc,BPR,htBleed,W31,W32.
7. Centered rolling-median window=5 + clip to mean±4σ on retained sensors.
8. Synthetic UTC timestamps: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z + (cycle-1) hours (cycle index → hourly TempusBench schema; not wall-clock flight hours).
9. Write cmapss_fd001_unit*.parquet then TempusBench CSV (context_window=168, forecast_horizon=14).
